primary.question: RQ1: does a candidate classifier learned from the library beat transferring grasps from parts of similar size?
RQ5: does adaptive stacking of transfer sources improve on the learned classifier?
RQ2/RQ3: inside the best system, is the image model (DINOv3) worth less than a 25% change in candidates examined?
RQ3: does pretraining beat the same ViT with random weights (5 initialisations pooled)?

note: Unit of analysis: the part. Test parts are never in the library, so outcomes are independent given the frozen library; rows of one part are not independent.
